details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> vulkan: make the radix top-k tie selection deterministic (#31931) * vulkan: make the radix top-k tie selection deterministic The radix select gathers the elements above the threshold and the ties with an atomic counter, so with more ties than remaining slots the kept columns depend on the thread scheduling. Each subgroup now owns a contiguous chunk of the row with the same column mapping in every pass, counts its kept elements, and writes them at ranks from a scan of the subgroup totals; overflowing ties are ranked in column order with a ballot, so the lowest tied columns win, as on CUDA and Metal. The radix pipelines require subgroup arithmetic, ballot and full subgroups. Enable the deterministic top-k check on Vulkan. * optimize shader for AMD, Intel and Nvidia --------- Co-authored-by: Ruben Ortlam <rortlam@redhat.com> </details> **Website:** - <https://llama.app> **Attestations:** - <https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/attestations/68092644> **macOS/iOS:** - [macOS

details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> webgpu: support per-head flash attention masks (#32394) The flash attention shaders indexed the mask without its head dimension, so masks with ne[2] > 1 gave wrong results. The mask offset and the vec block states now include the head, broadcast as head % mask->ne[2] like the other backends. The params buffer grows to 256 bytes to fit the two new mask fields. The shared memory estimate dropped kv_shmem when only one of K and V is read directly, while the shaders keep it unless both are, which made the K f16 / V q8_0 cases exceed the workgroup storage limit. The vec kv tile now takes both flags: the memory estimate drops kv_shmem only when both are direct, and the tile still divides the KV padding when either is. get_alloc_size and supports_op use the same rule as the pipelines, and supports_op accounts for the register tile fallback. </details> **Website:** - <https://llama.app> **Attestations:** - <https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/attestations/68155639> **macOS/iOS

Every call with more than one query row takes this path, including each speculative-decoding verify step, so the objects pile up and the server slows with every request. * opencl: keep q8_0 K/V at head size 512 off the WMM flash-attention kernel With q8_0 K/V at DK=512 the bin flash-attention kernel gives wrong results whenever V holds different values from K (test-backend-ops FLASH_ATTN_EXT hsk=512 q8_0, max error 2.04 on X2-90); f16 K/V at DK=512 is correct.
